info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MetaVia, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing and commercializing multi-modal disease-modifying therapies. Its pipeline includes ANA001, a proprietary oral niclosamide formulation, Gemcabene, which is assessed as an acute indication for COVID-19, NB-01, a treatment for painful diabetic neuropathy, and NB-02, which has the potential to treat the symptoms of cognitive impairment and modify the progression of neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded on October 30, 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: MetaVia, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發和商業化多模式疾病緩解療法。其產品線包括 ANA001（一種專有的口服氯硝柳胺製劑）、Gemcabene（被評估為 COVID-19 的急性適應症）、NB-01（一種治療疼痛性糖尿病神經病變的藥物）和 NB-02（有潛力治療認知障礙症狀並改變神經退化性疾病的進展）。該公司成立於2014年10月30日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that engages in developing and marketing a disruptive technology for drugs, nutraceuticals & supplements. The company was founded on February 2, 2025 and is headquartered in Estero, FL.
info.description_zh: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和行銷藥物、營養保健品和補充劑的顛覆性技術。該公司成立於 2025 年 2 月 2 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州埃斯特羅。

info.description: Hennessy Advisors, Inc. engages in the provision of investment advisory services to a family of open-ended mutual funds and an exchange-traded fund. It offers exchange-traded funds, traditional equity, specialty category, and sector funds, as well as more conservative multi-asset products. The company was founded by Neil Joseph Hennessy on February 1, 1989 and is headquartered in Novato, CA.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Advisors, Inc. 致力於為一系列開放式共同基金和交易所交易基金提供投資諮詢服務。它提供交易所交易基金、傳統股票、專業類別和行業基金，以及更保守的多元資產產品。該公司由 Neil Joseph Hennessy 於 1989 年 2 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州諾瓦托。

info.description: Cardiff Oncology, Inc. is an oncology therapeutics company, which engages in the development of drugs that target mitosis for the treatment of various types of cancer. The firm is focused on developing onvansertib, a first-in-class, third-generation Polo-like Kinase 1 (PLK1) inhibitor, in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy and targeted therapeutics. Its clinical programs include KRAS-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC), Resistant Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC) and relapsed or refractory Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML). The company was founded by Gabriel M. Cerrone, L. David Tomei, Samuil Umansky, and Hovsep Melkonyan in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cardiff Oncology, Inc.是一家腫瘤治療公司，致力於開發針對有絲分裂的藥物，用於治療各種類型的癌症。該公司專注於開發 onvansertib，這是一種一流的第三代 Polo 樣激酶 1 (PLK1) 抑制劑，與標準護理化療和標靶治療相結合。其臨床項目包括 KRAS 突變的轉移性結直腸癌 (mCRC)、抗藥性轉移性去勢抵抗性前列腺癌 (mCRPC) 和復發或難治性急性髓系白血病 (AML)。該公司由 Gabriel M. Cerrone、L. David Tomei、Samuil Umansky 和 ​​Hovsep Melkonyan 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Ulta Beauty, Inc. engages in the retail of beauty products. The firm also includes salon and e-commerce services. Its products include makeup, skin care, tools and brushes, fragrance, and bath and body. The company was founded on January 9, 1990 and is headquartered in Bolingbrook, IL.

Its product pipeline includes SER-109, SER-287, SER-301, and SER-401. The company was founded by Geoffrey von Maltzahn, David A. Berry, and Noubar B. Afeyan on October 18, 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Seres Therapeutics, Inc.透過微生物組治療平台從事生物藥物的開發。其產品線包括SER-109、SER-287、SER-301和SER-401。該公司由 Geoffrey von Maltzahn、David A. Berry 和 Noubar B. Afeyan 於 2010 年 10 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Global Indemnity Group LLC engages in the provision of diversified insurance and reinsurance services. It operates through the following segments: Agency and Insurance Services, Belmont Core, and Belmont Non-Core. The Agency and Insurance Services segment engages in insurance distribution, underwriting support, claims adjustment and administration, and insurance technology services through managing general agencies and related service entities. The Belmont Core segment engages in operations for ongoing direct insurance and assumed reinsurance products. The Belmont Non-Core segment engages in the insurance company operations for lines of business that have been de-emphasized. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.

info.description_zh: Global Indemnity Group LLC 從事提供多元化保險和再保險服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：代理商和保險服務部門、貝爾蒙特核心部門和貝爾蒙特非核心部門。代理和保險服務部門透過管理一般代理機構和相關服務實體從事保險分銷、承保支援、索賠調整和管理以及保險技術服務。貝爾蒙特核心部門從事持續直接保險和假定再保險產品的業務。貝爾蒙特非核心部門從事已不再強調的業務線的保險公司業務。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Summit Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of patient, physician, caregiver, and societal-friendly medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and resolve serious unmet medical needs. The firm conducts clinical programs focusing on Clostridioides Difficile Infection (CDI). Its lead product, Ridinilazole, is an orally administered small molecule antibiotic that is in Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of CDI. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

info.description: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation by actively investing in equity securities of energy-related companies or instruments providing exposure to energy-related companies. The strategy targets full market capitalization representation across the energy sector to minimize tracking error and performance deviation relative to traditional broad sector benchmarks.
info.description_zh: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF 透過積極投資能源相關公司的股本證券或提供能源相關公司曝險的工具來尋求長期資本增值。該策略的目標是整個能源行業的完整市值代表性，以最大限度地減少相對於傳統廣泛行業基準的追蹤誤差和績效偏差。

info.description: Prothena Corp. Plc is a clinical-stage neuroscience company, which engages in the discovery and development of novel therapies to change the course of devastating diseases. The firm's clinical pipeline includes both wholly owned and partnered programs being developed for the potential treatment of diseases including AL amyloidosis, ATTR amyloidosis, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded in December 1969 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Prothena Corp. Plc 是一家臨床階段的神經科學公司，致力於發現和開發新療法以改變破壞性疾病的進程。該公司的臨床管道包括正在開發的全資和合作項目，用於潛在治療 AL 澱粉樣變性、ATTR 澱粉樣變性、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症和其他神經退化性疾病。該公司成立於1969年12月，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long META Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.50 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial Institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Underlying Stock.

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment and Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment. The Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical, and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products in the United States. The Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, which are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, and other markets. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和專業解決方案部門以及全球醫療產品和分銷部門運營。製藥和專業解決方案部門在美國分銷品牌和仿製藥、專業藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。全球醫療產品和分銷部門生產、採購和分銷 Cardinal Health 品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品，這些產品銷往美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞洲和其他市場。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: ScanSource, Inc. engages in the development and provision of technology products and services. It operates through the Specialty Technology Solutions and Intelisys & Advisory segments. The Specialty Technology Solutions segment includes enterprise mobile computing, data capture, barcode printing, POS, payments, networking, electronic physical security, cybersecurity and other technologies. The Intelisys & Advisory segment refers to the United States and consists of sales and services to both channel sales partners (Intelisys) and end users (Advisory). The company was founded by Michael L. Baur and Steven H. Owings in December 1992 and is headquartered in Greenville, SC.
info.description_zh: ScanSource, Inc. 從事技術產品和服務的開發和提供。它透過專業技術解決方案和 Intelisys 與諮詢部門運作。專業技術解決方案部門包括企業行動運算、資料收集、條碼列印、POS、支付、網路、電子實體安全、網路安全和其他技術。 Intelisys 和諮詢部門涉及美國，包括向通路銷售合作夥伴 (Intelisys) 和最終用戶 (Advisory) 提供的銷售和服務。該公司由 Michael L. Baur 和 Steven H. Owings 於 1992 年 12 月創立，總部位於南卡羅來納州格林維爾。

info.description: Defiance Oil Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; secondary objective being exposure to the performance of United States Oil Fund, LP ("USO") subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the share price of United States Oil Fund, LP, subject to a limit on potential gains related to increases in the price of USO's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Oil 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；次要目標是了解美國石油基金有限合夥人（「USO」）的業績，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 United States Oil Fund, LP 股價的機會，但受到與 USO 股價上漲相關的潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ascendis Pharma A/S is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drug candidates. It specializes in its TransCon technologies to develop new therapies that address unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Jan Moller Mikkelsen, Dirk Vetter, and Harald Rau on September 21, 2006 and is headquartered in Hellerup, Denmark.
info.description_zh: Ascendis Pharma A/S 是一家生物製藥公司，從事候選藥物的開發。它專注於 TransCon 技術來開發新療法，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司由 Jan Moller Mikkelsen、Dirk Vetter 和 Harald Rau 於 2006 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於丹麥海勒魯普。

info.description: JPMorgan Managed Futures Plus ETF combines a strategic, long-term large-capitalization U.S. equity exposure with a systematic, model-driven managed futures strategy that takes long and short positions globally across equities, fixed income, currencies, and commodities. The fund implements its multi-asset framework via direct stock investments and substantial derivative exposures, while managing a portion of its commodity risk through a wholly owned Cayman Islands subsidiary.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通管理期貨Plus ETF將戰略性長期大盤美國股票敞口與系統化、模型驅動的管理期貨策略相結合，該策略在全球範圍內持有股票、固定收益、貨幣和大宗商品的多頭和空頭頭寸。該基金透過直接股票投資和大量衍生性商品曝險實施其多元資產框架，同時透過全資擁有的開曼群島子公司管理部分商品風險。

info.description: Jones Ventures INTL Acquisition1 Corp is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on June 15, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

It operates through the Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL) segments. The FoA segment consists of Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and other services. The RL segment includes augmented, mixed and virtual reality related consumer hardware, software, and content. The company was founded by Mark Elliot Zuckerberg, Dustin Moskovitz, Chris R. Hughes, Andrew McCollum, and Eduardo P. Saverin on February 4, 2004, and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.

info.description_zh: Meta Platforms, Inc. 從事社群媒體應用程式的開發。它開發的技術可以幫助人們聯繫和分享、尋找社區和發展業務。它透過應用程式家族 (FoA) 和現實實驗室 (RL) 部門運作。 FoA 部分包括 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、WhatsApp 和其他服務。強化學習領域包括擴增實境、混合實境和虛擬實境相關的消費硬體、軟體和內容。該公司由 Mark Elliot Zuckerberg、Dustin Moskovitz、Chris R. Hughes、Andrew McCollum 和 Eduardo P. Saverin 於 2004 年 2 月 4 日創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. engages in the production of oilseeds, corn, wheat, cocoa, and other agricultural commodities. It operates through the following segments: Ag Services and Oilseeds, Carbohydrate Solutions, Nutrition, and Other. The Ag Services and Oilseeds segment includes activities related to the origination, merchandising, transportation, and storage of agricultural raw materials, and the crushing and further processing of oilseeds such as soybeans and soft seeds cottonseed, sunflower seed, canola, rapeseed, and flaxseed into vegetable oils and protein meals. The Carbohydrate Solutions segment consists of corn and wheat wet and dry milling and other activities. The Nutrition segment serves various end markets including food, beverages, nutritional supplements, and feed and premix for livestock, aquaculture, and pet food. The Other segment refers to the company's remaining operations. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. 從事油籽、玉米、小麥、可可和其他農產品的生產。它透過以下部門運作：農業服務和油籽部門、碳水化合物解決方案部門、營養部門和其他部門。農業服務和油籽部門包括與農業原料的原產地、銷售、運輸和儲存有關的活動，以及將大豆和軟籽棉籽、葵花籽、油菜籽、油菜籽和亞麻籽等油籽壓榨和深加工成植物油和蛋白粉的活動。碳水化合物解決方案部門包括玉米和小麥的濕磨和乾磨以及其他活動。營養部門服務於各種終端市場，包括食品、飲料、營養補充劑以及牲畜、水產養殖和寵物食品的飼料和預混料。其他部門是指公司的剩餘業務。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Materialise NV engages in the provision of additive manufacturing software and 3D printing services. It operates through the following segments: Materialise Software, Materialise Medical, and Materialise Manufacturing. The Materialise Software segment offers proprietary software worldwide through programs and platforms that enable companies to set up reliable and sustainable 3D printing production. The Materialise Medical segment includes medical software solutions, medical devices and other related products and services. The Materialise Manufacturing segment provides 3D printed services to industrial and commercial customers. The company was founded by Wilfried Vancraen and Hilde Ingelaere on June 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Materialise NV 從事提供積層製造軟體和 3D 列印服務。它透過以下部門運作：Materialize Software、Materialise Medical 和 Materialise Manufacturing。 Materialise Software 部門透過程式和平台在全球範圍內提供專有軟體，使公司能夠建立可靠且可持續的 3D 列印生產。 Materialise Medical 部門包括醫療軟體解決方案、醫療設備以及其他相關產品和服務。 Materialise Manufacturing 部門為工業和商業客戶提供 3D 列印服務。該公司由 Wilfried Vancraen 和 Hilde Ingelaere 於 1990 年 6 月 28 日創立，總部位於比利時魯汶。

info.description: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It operates through the Banking and Consumer Finance segments. The firm also offers non-banking activities, such as securities underwriting and dealing activities, insurance agency and underwriting activities, and merchant banking and equity investment activities. The company was founded on January 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Gallipolis, OH.
info.description_zh: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它透過銀行和消費金融部門運作。該公司還提供非銀行業務，例如證券承銷和交易活動、保險代理和承銷活動以及商業銀行和股權投資活動。該公司成立於1992年1月8日，總部位於俄亥俄州加利波利斯。

info.description: Gladstone Capital Corp. is real estate investment trust, which owns net leased industrial, commercial, retail property and selectively makes long-term industrial and commercial mortgage loans. It offers debt and equity financing for growth, acquisition and recapitalization with an investment. The company was founded by David J. Gladstone on May 30, 2001 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Gladstone Capital Corp.是一家房地產投資信託公司，擁有淨租賃的工業、商業、零售物業，並選擇性地提供長期工業和商業抵押貸款。它透過投資為成長、收購和資本重組提供債務和股權融資。該公司由 David J. Gladstone 於 2001 年 5 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. engages in the provision of consumer technology products and services. It operates through two business segments: Domestic and International. The Domestic segment includes operations in all states and territories of the U.S., operating under various brand names, including Best Buy, Best Buy Mobile, Geek Squad, Magnolia Audio Video, and Pacific Sales. The International segment consists of operations in Canada. It also markets its products under the brand names: Best Buy, bestbuy.com, Best Buy Express, Lively, Geek Squad, Magnolia and Pacific Kitchen and Home. The company was founded by Richard M. Schulze in 1966 and is headquartered in Richfield, MN.
info.description_zh: Best Buy Co., Inc. 從事提供消費性科技產品和服務。它透過兩個業務部門運作：國內和國際。國內部門包括在美國所有州和地區的業務，以各種品牌運營，包括 Best Buy、Best Buy Mobile、Geek Squad、Magnolia Audio Video 和 Pacific Sales。國際部門包括加拿大的業務。它還以以下品牌銷售其產品：Best Buy、bestbuy.com、Best Buy Express、Lively、Geek Squad、Magnolia 和 Pacific Kitchen and Home。該公司由 Richard M. Schulze 於 1966 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州里奇菲爾德。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The Sub-Adviser defines U.S. companies as companies whose securities are traded principally in the United States or that have their principal place of business in the United States. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。副顧問將美國公司定義為證券主要在美國交易或主要營業地點在美國的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AgomAb Therapeutics NV is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel disease-modifying therapies for immunology and inflammatory diseases. Its mission is to develop disease-modifying therapeutics that aim to resolve fibrosis and restore organ function, enabling patients with these disorders to live fuller and healthier lives. The company was founded by Paolo Michieli, Manuela Cazzanti, Virginia Morello, Federica Caterina Linty, Michael Potter Saunders, and Hans J. W. de Haard in 2017 and is headquartered in Ghent, Belgium.
info.description_zh: AgomAb Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發免疫學和發炎性疾病的新型疾病緩解療法。其使命是開發疾病緩解療法，旨在解決纖維化問題並恢復器官功能，使患有這些疾病的患者能夠過上更充實、更健康的生活。該公司由 Paolo Michieli、Manuela Cazzanti、Virginia Morello、Federica Caterina Linty、Michael Potter Saunders 和 Hans J. W. de Haard 於 2017 年創立，總部位於比利時根特。

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: Belite Bio, Inc. engages in the research and development of drugs. It focuses on the treatment of eye diseases involving retinal degeneration such as atrophic age-related macular degeneration and autosomal recessive Stargardt disease. It also caters to metabolic diseases such as non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, type 2 diabetes, and gout. The company was founded by Yu-Hsin Lin on March 27, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Belite Bio, Inc. 從事藥物的研究和開發。它專注於治療涉及視網膜變性的眼部疾病，例如萎縮性老年黃斑部病變和體染色體隱性遺傳斯塔加特氏症。它也針對非酒精性脂肪肝、非酒精性脂肪性肝炎、第二型糖尿病和痛風等代謝性疾病。該公司由 Yu-Hsin Lin 於 2018 年 3 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Bank7 Corp. is bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking solutions. The company was founded by William Brad Haines in 2004 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, OK.
info.description_zh: Bank7 Corp.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供銀行解決方案。該公司由 William Brad Haines 於 2004 年創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州俄克拉荷馬市。

info.description: Single-stock leveraged ETF that seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2x (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Bitdeer Technologies Group (BTDR).
info.description_zh: 單股槓桿 ETF，尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Bitdeer Technologies Group (BTDR) 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。

info.description: Bitdeer Technologies Group engages in the cryptocurrency mining industry. It generates income through its proprietary mining datacenters. The firm handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. The company was founded by Wu Jihan in December 2021 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 比特鹿科技集團從事加密貨幣挖礦產業。它透過其專有的採礦資料中心產生收入。該公司處理與計算相關的複雜流程，如設備採購、運輸物流、資料中心設計和建造、設備管理和日常營運。該公司由吳忌寒於2021年12月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: REX Crypto Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies comprising the BITA Crypto Assets & Digital Payments Index. The index is a rules-based composite index that tracks the market performance of 25 companies, listed on regulated exchanges based in the U.S., that are actively engaged in crypto-related activities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX 加密股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於包含 BITA 加密資產和數位支付指數的公司的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的綜合指數，追蹤 25 家在美國受監管交易所上市、積極從事加密貨幣相關活動的公司的市場表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lionheart Holdings operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or other similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 21, 2024 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Lionheart Holdings 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Citizens Community Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company for Citizens Community Federal Bank. It provides commercial, agricultural and consumer banking services. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Eau Claire, WI.

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: WEBs Consumer Discretionary XLY Defined Volatility ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLY Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the consumer discretionary sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs 非必需消費品 XLY 定義波動率 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax 定義波動率 XLY 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場非必需消費品產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Macquarie Focused Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging markets issuers. The fund invests primarily in a broad range of equity securities of companies located in emerging market countries and may invest in companies of any size. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.

info.description: First Trust Enhanced Short Maturity ETF seeks current income, consistent with preservation of capital and daily liquidity. Under normal market conditions, the Advisor intends to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets in a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed- and variable-rate debt securities. Normally the fund's portfolio is expected to have an average duration of less than one year and an average maturity of less than three years.

info.description: Ferroglobe PLC is a holding company, which engages in the production of silicon and specialty metals. The firm's products include silicon metal, manganese alloys, ferrosilicon, calcium silicon, and electrodes. It operates through the following segments: North America Silicon Metals, North America Silicon Alloys, Europe Manganese, Europe Silicon Metals, Europe Silicon Alloys, South Africa Silicon Metals, South Africa Silicon Alloys, and Other. The company was founded on February 5, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Ferroglobe PLC 是一家控股公司，從事矽和特種金屬的生產。該公司的產品包括金屬矽、錳合金、矽鐵、矽鈣和電極。它透過以下部門運作：北美金屬矽部門、北美矽合金部門、歐洲錳部門、歐洲金屬矽部門、歐洲矽合金部門、南非金屬矽部門、南非矽合金部門等。該公司成立於2015年2月5日，總部位於英國倫敦。

The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求 NVDA 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. info.description: VersaBank engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through Digital Banking and DRTC. The Digital Banking segment offers business to business model using its financial technoolgy to address issues in the U.S. banking market. The DRTC segment refers to developed IT security software and capabilities. The company was founded by David Roy Taylor on January 18, 1993 and is headquartered in London, Canada.
info.description_zh: VersaBank 從事提供金融服務。它透過數位銀行和 DRTC 運作。數位銀行部門利用其金融科技提供企業對企業模式來解決美國銀行市場的問題。 DRTC 部分是指開發的 IT 安全軟體和功能。該公司由David Roy Taylor於1993年1月18日創立，總部位於加拿大倫敦。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. The fund seeks to achieve 200% of the income derived from standard option strategies on the reference asset while maintaining exposure to the underlying leveraged instrument, albeit constrained by a cap on potential capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產的標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: Xsolla SPAC 1 is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Aleksandr Agapitov on September 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Sherman Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: Xsolla SPAC 1 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Aleksandr Agapitov 於 2025 年 9 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州謝爾曼奧克斯。

info.description: S&P Global, Inc. engages in the provision of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics, and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide. It operates through the following segments: Ratings, Indices, Energy, and Market Intelligence. The Ratings segment provides credit ratings, research, and analytics. The Indices segment maintains a wide variety of valuation and index benchmarks for investment advisors, wealth managers, and institutional investors. The Energy segment is involved in information and benchmark prices for the energy and commodity markets. The Market Intelligence segment covers multi-asset-class data and analytics integrated with purpose-built workflow solutions. The company was founded by James H. McGraw and John A. Hill in 1917 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: S&P Global, Inc. 致力於向全球資本和商品市場提供透明和獨立的評級、基準、分析和數據。它透過以下部門運作：評級、指數、能源和市場情報。評級部門提供信用評級、研究和分析。指數部門為投資顧問、財富管理機構和機構投資者維護各種估值和指數基準。能源部門涉及能源和商品市場的資訊和基準價格。市場情報部門涵蓋與專門建構的工作流程解決方案整合的多資產類別資料和分析。該公司由 James H. McGraw 和 John A. Hill 於 1917 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Lazard Japanese Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equities and equity-related securities (i.e., shares, including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights) traded on markets in Japan. The investment manager seeks to invest in the equity and equity-related securities of companies operating in sectors which have been identified through research undertaken by the Investment Manager as showing greater potential for growth at any given point of the economic cycle. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard 日本股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於在日本市場交易的股票和股票相關證券（即股票，包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利）。投資經理尋求投資於投資經理進行的研究已確定在經濟週期的任何給定點顯示出更大增長潛力的行業中運營的公司的股權和股權相關證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily META Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of META. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of META and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to META, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily META Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 META 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 META 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 META 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tuniu Corp. is an online leisure travel company, which engages in the provision of travel-related services in China. It offers packaged tours, including organized tours and self-guided tours, and also travel-related services for leisure travelers. Its product portfolio includes organized tours, self-guided tours, and tickets for various domestic and overseas tourist attractions. The company was founded by Dunde Yu and Hai Feng Yan in 2006 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
info.description_zh: 途牛公司是一家線上休閒旅遊公司，在中國提供旅遊相關服務。它為休閒遊客提供跟團遊和自助遊等跟團遊以及旅遊相關服務。其產品組合包括跟團遊、自助遊以及國內外各個旅遊景點的門票。該公司由於敦德和嚴海峰於2006年創立，總部位於中國南京。

info.description: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月3日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Epsilon Energy Ltd. engages in the business of acquiring, developing, gathering, and producing natural gas and oil reserves. It operates through the following segments: Upstream, and Gathering System. The Upstream segment includes the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas reserves. The Gathering System segment deals with natural gas gathering system. The company was founded by Zoran Arandjelovic and John K. Wilson on March 14, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Epsilon Energy Ltd. 從事收購、開發、收集和生產天然氣和石油儲備的業務。它透過以下部分運作：上游和收集系統。上游部門包括石油和天然氣儲量的收購、勘探、開發和生產。收集系統部門涉及天然氣收集系統。該公司由 Zoran Arandjelovic 和 John K. Wilson 於 2005 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Pacira Biosciences, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of non-opioid pain management and regenerative health solutions to improve patients' journeys along the neural pain pathway. Its products include EXPAREL, iovera, and DepoFoam. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.

Its products include single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, access gateway, API access management, authentication, adaptive MFA and lifecycle management. The company was founded by Todd McKinnon and J. Frederic Kerrest in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cave, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 9 月 27 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cave。

info.description: Quantum Cyber NV engages in assembling an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered, quantum-accelerated system-of-systems autonomous defense platform. It integrates drone warfare, counter-UAS, autonomous naval mine countermeasures, EMP shielding, anti-drone ammunition, command-and-control, and quantum antenna applications. The company was founded on March 8, 2021 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Quantum Cyber​​ NV 致力於組裝由人工智慧 (AI) 驅動、量子加速的系統級系統自主防禦平台。它整合了無人機作戰、反無人機、自主水雷對抗、電磁脈衝屏蔽、反無人機彈藥、指揮控制和量子天線應用。該公司成立於 2021 年 3 月 8 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the business of developing and commercializing novel therapeutics based on ribonucleic acid interference. The company was founded by Noble Laureate, David Bartel, Thomas Tuschl, Phillip Zamore, Paul R. Schimmel, and Phillip Allen Sharp on June 14, 2002, and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事基於核糖核酸幹擾的新型療法的開發和商業化業務。該公司由諾貝爾獎得主 David Bartel、Thomas Tuschl、Phillip Zamore、Paul R. Schimmel 和 Phillip Allen Sharp 於 2002 年 6 月 14 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: The Children's Place, Inc. engages in the provision of apparel, footwear, accessories, and other items for children. The firm also designs contracts to manufacture and sell fashionable and value-priced merchandise under the brand names of The Children's Place, Baby Place, and Gymboree. It operates through the following segments: The Children's Place U.S. and The Children's Place International. The Children's Place U.S. segment refers to the company's U.S. and Puerto Rico-based stores and revenue from its U.S. based wholesale business. The Children's Place International segment is involved in the Canadian-based stores, revenue from the company's Canadian-based wholesale business and revenue from international franchisees. The company was founded by David Pulver and Clinton A. Clark in 1969 and is headquartered in Secaucus, NJ.
info.description_zh: The Children's Place, Inc. 從事為兒童提供服裝、鞋類、配件和其他物品的業務。該公司還設計合同，以 The Children's Place、Baby Place 和 Gymboree 品牌製造和銷售時尚且物有所值的商品。它透過以下部門運作：The Children's Place U.S. 和 The Children's Place International。 Children's Place 美國部門是指該公司位於美國和波多黎各的商店以及來自美國批發業務的收入。 Children's Place International 部門涉及加拿大的商店、公司加拿大批發業務的收入以及國際特許經營商的收入。該公司由 David Pulver 和 Clinton A. Clark 於 1969 年創立，總部位於新澤西州錫考克斯。

info.description: Cosmos Health, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company, which engages in the importation, exportation, distribution, and sale of pharmaceutical products. It is also involved in the research and development of its business units, and acquisition of pharmaceutical companies. The firm offers over-the-counter drugs, branded and generic medicines, and dietary and vitamin supplements. The company was founded on July 21, 2009 and is headquartered in Thessaloniki, Greece.
info.description_zh: Cosmos Health, Inc.是一家製藥公司，從事醫藥產品的進口、出口、分銷和銷售。它也參與其業務部門的研發以及製藥公司的收購。該公司提供非處方藥、品牌藥和仿製藥、膳食補充劑和維生素補充劑。該公司成立於2009年7月21日，總部位於希臘塞薩洛尼基。

info.description: DLocal Ltd. engages in the business of simplifying and redefining online payments experience. It focuses on processing payment transactions which enables merchants to get paid from customers and to make payments to customers in emerging markets. The company was founded by Andres Bzurovski Bay and Sergio Enrique Fogel Kaplan in 2016 and is headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay.

info.description: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of conditionally activated, biologics localized to the tumor microenvironment. The company was founded by Frederick W. Gluck and Nancy E. Stagliano in September 2010 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc.是一家專注於腫瘤學的臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對腫瘤微環境的條件激活生物製劑。該公司由 Frederick W. Gluck 和 Nancy E. Stagliano 於 2010 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Bunge Global SA engages in agribusiness including food and ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Agribusiness, Refined & Specialty Oils, Milling, Sugar & Bioenergy, and Corporate & Other. The Agribusiness segment is an integrated, global business principally involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, processing and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products. The Refined & Specialty Oils segment includes businesses that sell vegetable oils and fats, including cooking oils, shortenings, specialty ingredients, and renewable diesel feedstocks. The Milling segment refers to the businesses that sell wheat flours, bakery mixes, and corn-based products. The Sugar & Bioenergy segment consists of results from the company's previously owned 50% ownership interest in BP Bunge Bioenergia. The Corporate & Other segment focuses on the salaries and overhead for corporate functions that are not allocated to individual reporting segments because the operating performance of such reporting segments is evaluated. It connects farmers to consumers to deliver essential and sustainable food, feed and fuel. The company was founded on February 14, 2023 and is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO.
info.description_zh: Bunge Global SA 從事農業綜合業務，包括食品和配料。它透過以下部門運作：農業綜合企業、精煉和特種油、製粉、糖和生物能源以及企業和其他部門。農業綜合企業部門是一家綜合性、全球性企業，主要涉及農產品和大宗商品的採購、儲存、運輸、加工和銷售。精煉和特種油部門包括銷售植物油和脂肪的業務，包括食用油、起酥油、特殊成分和再生柴油原料。製粉部門是指銷售小麥麵粉、烘焙混合物和玉米產品的業務。糖業和生質能源部門包括該公司先前擁有 BP Bunge Bioenergia 50% 股權的表現。公司及其他分部重點關注公司職能的薪資和間接費用，這些職能未分配給各個報告分部，因為要評估此類報告分部的經營業績。它將農民與消費者聯繫起來，提供基本且永續的食品、飼料和燃料。該公司成立於 2023 年 2 月 14 日，總部位於密蘇裡州切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: Varonis Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of a security software platform. Its software enables enterprises and industries to protect data stored in the cloud and on-premises including sensitive files and emails, confidential personal data belonging to customers, patients, and employees, financial records, source code, strategic, and product plans, and other intellectual property. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Rest of the World. The company was founded by Yakov Faitelson and Ohad Korkus on November 3, 2004 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Varonis Systems, Inc. 從事提供安全軟體平台。其軟體使企業和行業能夠保護儲存在雲端和本地的數據，包括敏感文件和電子郵件、屬於客戶、患者和員工的機密個人資料、財務記錄、原始程式碼、策略和產品計劃以及其他智慧財產權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東、非洲以及世界其他地區。該公司由 Yakov Faitelson 和 Ohad Korkus 於 2004 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: GoDaddy, Inc. engages in the provision of simple and easy-to-use products on a single technology platform, complemented by personalized guidance. It operates through the following segments: Applications and Commerce (A&C) and Core Platform (Core). The Applications and Commerce (A&C) segment sells products containing proprietary software, commerce solutions, third-party email services, productivity tools, and certain products bundled with proprietary software offerings. The Core Platform (Core) segment provides domain registrations and renewals, aftermarket domain sales, website hosting services, website security products that are not included in bundled proprietary software offerings, and other products that do not contain a software component. The company was founded by Robert R. Parsons in 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: GoDaddy, Inc. 致力於在單一技術平台上提供簡單易用的產品，並輔以個人化指導。它透過以下部門運作：應用程式和商務（A＆C）以及核心平台（Core）。應用程式和商務 (A&C) 部門銷售的產品包含專有軟體、商務解決方案、第三方電子郵件服務、生產力工具以及與專有軟體產品捆綁在一起的某些產品。核心平台（核心）部門提供網域名稱註冊和續約、售後網域銷售、網站寄存服務、不包含在捆綁專有軟體產品中的網站安全產品以及其他不包含軟體元件的產品。該公司由 Robert R. Parsons 於 1997 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: BlackLine, Inc. engages in providing a cloud-based software platform that automates and controls financial close and accounting processes. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Therese Tucker in May 2001 and is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: BlackLine, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體平台，可自動執行和控制財務結算和會計流程。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Therese Tucker 於 2001 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州伍德蘭希爾斯。

info.description: SBA Communications Corp. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the provision of wireless communications infrastructures. It operates through the following business segments: Domestic Site Leasing, International Site Leasing, and Site Development. The Domestic Site Leasing segment includes AT&T, Sprint, T-Mobile, and Verizon Wireless. The International Site Leasing segment acquires and develops towers. The Site Development segment is involved in consulting and construction activities. The company was founded by Steven E. Bernstein in 1989 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: SBA Communications Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事提供無線通訊基礎設施業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：國內場地租賃、國際場地租賃和場地開發。國內站點租賃部門包括 AT&T、Sprint、T-Mobile 和 Verizon Wireless。國際場地租賃部門收購和開發塔樓。場地開發部門從事諮詢和建設活動。該公司由 Steven E. Bernstein 於 1989 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Apple, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and other varieties of related services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific. The Americas segment includes North and South America. The Europe segment consists of European countries, as well as India, the Middle East, and Africa. The Greater China segment comprises China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. The Rest of Asia Pacific segment includes Australia and Asian countries. Its products and services include iPhone, Mac, iPad, AirPods, Apple TV, Apple Watch, Beats products, AppleCare, iCloud, digital content stores, streaming, and licensing services. The company was founded by Steven Paul Jobs, Ronald Gerald Wayne, and Stephen G. Wozniak in April 1976 and is headquartered in Cupertino, CA.

info.description: Intrusion, Inc. is a cybersecurity company, which offers customers access to its exclusive threat intelligence database containing the historical data, known associations, and reputational behavior of Internet Protocol addresses. Its solutions include INTRUSION Shield, INTRUSION TraceCop, and INTRUSION Savant. The company was founded by T. Joe Head and G. Ward Paxton in September 1983 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Intrusion, Inc. 是一家網路安全公司，為客戶提供存取其獨家威脅情報資料庫的權限，其中包含網際網路協定位址的歷史資料、已知關聯和聲譽行為。其解決方案包括 INTRUSION Shield、INTRUSION TraceCop 和 INTRUSION Savant。該公司由 T. Joe Head 和 G. Ward Paxton 於 1983 年 9 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing medicines to target diseases driven by abnormally elevated aldosterone. Its clinical-stage product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor that are initially developing for the treatment of cardiorenal conditions affected by abnormally elevated aldosterone, including hypertension and chronic kidney disease. The company was founded by Brian Taylor Slingsby on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.
info.description_zh: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發針對由醛固酮異常升高引起的疾病的藥物。其臨床階段候選產品lorundrostat是一種專有的口服高選擇性醛固酮合成酶抑制劑，最初開發用於治療受醛固酮異常升高影響的心腎疾病，包括高血壓和慢性腎臟病。該公司由 Brian Taylor Slingsby 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州拉德諾。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.75x Long AAPL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.75 times (175%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Apple Inc. The fund is an actively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.75 times (175%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The adviser will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the adviser and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.

The company was founded by Shahan Ohanessian and Shoushana Ohanessian on January 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: VenHub Global, Inc. 從事全自動和機器人操作的便利商店的管理。它利用人工智慧（AI）和智慧庫存管理系統等技術來提升顧客的購物體驗。該公司由 Shahan Ohanessian 和 Shoushana Ohanessian 於 2023 年 1 月 31 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to the digital asset Dogecoin (DOGE). The Trust functions as a transparent investment vehicle, holding Dogecoin in institutional-grade custody to allow investors to participate in the price movements of the cryptocurrency without the complexities of managing digital wallets or private keys.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支持的數位資產狗狗幣 (DOGE) 曝險。該信託基金作為一種透明的投資工具，以機構級託管方式持有狗狗幣，使投資者能夠參與加密貨幣的價格變動，而無需管理數位錢包或私鑰的複雜性。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ Cybersecurity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity Index TM (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index includes securities of companies classified as "cyber security" companies by CTA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ Cyber​​security ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq CTA Cyber​​security Index TM（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數包括被 CTA 歸類為「網路安全」公司的公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ascentage Pharma Group International Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in the development of novel therapies for cancers, hepatitis B virus, or HBV, and age-related diseases. The company was founded by Da Jun Yang, Wang Shao Meng and Ming Guo in May 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 亞盛醫藥集團國際有限公司是一家臨床階段的生技公司。它致力於開發癌症、乙型肝炎病毒或 HBV 以及與年齡相關的疾病的新療法。該公司由楊大軍、王少萌和郭明於2009年5月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: WisdomTree Cybersecurity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance of the WisdomTree Team8 Cybersecurity Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to equity securities of exchange-listed companies globally, which are primarily involved in cybersecurity and security-oriented technology that generate a meaningful part of their revenue from cybersecurity activities and are experiencing revenue growth. To the extent the index concentrates in the securities of a particular industry or group of industries, the fund will concentrate its investments to approximately the same extent as the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 網路安全基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree Team8 網路安全指數的價格和收益率表現。該指數旨在提供全球交易所上市公司的股本證券敞口，這些公司主要涉及網路安全和安全導向技術，這些公司的收入中有很大一部分來自網路安全活動，並且正在經歷收入成長。如果指數集中於特定產業或產業組的證券，則基金的投資集中程度將與指數大致相同。它是非多元化的。

info.description: SL Science Holding Ltd. operates as a biomedical company. It operates through Exosome products, CD-19 Armed-T products, GDT cell therapy products, corporate and unallocated segments. The firm offers immune cell development, skincare product formulations, cellular and gene therapies. The company was founded by Ching Dong Wang on March 18, 2025 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cybersecurity seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity IndexSM. The index is a modified liquidity weighted index comprised of companies classified as "cybersecurity" companies by CTA. The Advisor expects that its cash balances maintained in connection with the use of financial instruments will typically be held in money market instruments. It invests in common stock issued by public companies. The fund invests in derivatives, which are financial instruments whose value is derived from the value of an underlying asset or assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cyber​​security 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於納斯達克 CTA 網路安全指數 SM 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該指數是修改後的流動性加權指數，由 CTA 歸類為「網路安全」公司的公司組成。顧問預計其與使用金融工具相關的現金餘額通常以貨幣市場工具持有。它投資於上市公司發行的普通股。該基金投資於衍生性商品，這些衍生性商品是其價值源自標的資產或資產的價值的金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Polyrizon Ltd. is a development stage biotech company, which engages in the development of nasal hydrogels. It provides barriers from the interaction of biological assaults, including a new strain of coronavirus, influenza, allergens and other airborne pathogens with the nasal epithelial tissue. The company was founded by Tomer Izraeli in January 2005 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.
info.description_zh: Polyrizon Ltd.是一家處於發展階段的生物技術公司，從事鼻腔水凝膠的開發。它為生物攻擊提供了屏障，包括新型冠狀病毒、流感、過敏原和其他空氣傳播的病原體與鼻上皮組織的相互作用。該公司由 Tomer Izraeli 於 2005 年 1 月創立，總部位於以色列 Raanana。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long CRWD Daily ETF seeks daily inverse investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: CRWD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2x (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long CRWD Daily ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果為 CrowdStrike Holdings Inc（納斯達克股票代碼：CRWD）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Synopsys, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design automation (EDA) software that engineers use to design and test integrated circuits (ICs). It also offers semiconductor intellectual property (IP) products. It operates through the Design Automation and Design IP segments. The Design Automation segment includes silicon design, verification of products and services, and Ansys products, and system integration of products and services. The Design IP segment refers to interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services that serve companies primarily in the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company was founded by Aart J. de Geus, Bill Krieger, Dave Gregory, and Rick Rudell in December 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Synopsys, Inc. 致力於提供工程師用來設計和測試積體電路 (IC) 的電子設計自動化 (EDA) 軟體。它還提供半導體知識產權（IP）產品。它透過設計自動化和設計 IP 部門運作。設計自動化部門包括晶片設計、產品和服務驗證、Ansys 產品以及產品和服務的系統整合。設計IP部分涉及介面、基礎、安全和嵌入式處理器IP、IP子系統和IP實施服務，主要為半導體和電子行業的公司提供服務。該公司由 Aart J. de Geus、Bill Krieger、Dave Gregory 和 Rick Rudell 於 1986 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PANW. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PANW and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PANW 每日業績的 200% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PANW 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 PANW 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PANW Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PANW. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PANW 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PANW 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PANW 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Meiwu Technology Co., Ltd. operates as an online and mobile commerce company. It engages in the business of selling food products through online retails stores and operates restaurants in China. The firm operates through the following reportable segments: Clean Food Platform, Technical Service, and Skincare Products and Service. The company was founded on December 4, 2018, and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 美物科技有限公司是一家線上和行動商務公司。該公司在中國從事透過網上零售店銷售食品的業務並經營餐廳。該公司透過以下可報告部門運作：清潔食品平台、技術服務以及護膚產品和服務。公司成立於2018年12月4日，總部位於中國深圳。

The company was founded by Andrew Stephen Gundlach and Michel Combes on August 27, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on its lead program, GRI-0621, an inhibitor of type 1 invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell activity and is being developed as a novel oral therapeutic for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded in May 2009 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: GRI Bio, Inc. 從事發炎、纖維化和自體免疫疾病療法的開發和商業化。該公司專注於其主導項目 GRI-0621，這是一種 1 型不變自然殺手 T (iNKT) 細胞活性抑制劑，正在開發為治療特發性肺纖維化的新型口服療法。該公司成立於 2009 年 5 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solution services. It provides tailor-made software solutions, cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) services, and white-labelled software design and development services. The company was founded by Kin Pong Shek on July 13, 2023, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供企業軟體解決方案服務。它提供量身定制的軟體解決方案、基於雲端的軟體即服務（SaaS）服務以及白標軟體設計和開發服務。該公司由Kin Pong Shek於2023年7月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. engages in the development of therapeutic products for the treatment of rare and orphan diseases. Its product pipeline includes QRX003, QRX004, QRX007, and QRX008. The company was founded by Michael Myers and Denise Carter on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.
info.description_zh: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. 從事治療罕見疾病和孤兒疾病的治療產品的開發。其產品線包括QRX003、QRX004、QRX007和QRX008。該公司由 Michael Myers 和 Denise Carter 於 2018 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿什本。

info.description: Gelteq Ltd. operates as a biotechnology company. It focuses on the development and commercialization of white label gel-based delivery solutions for prescription drugs, nutraceuticals, pet care, and other products. The firm also offers edible gels. The company was founded by Nathan J. Givoni and Simon H. Szewach on October 15, 2018 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Gelteq Ltd. 是一家生技公司。它專注於處方藥、營養保健品、寵物護理和其他產品的基於白標凝膠的輸送解決方案的開發和商業化。該公司還提供可食用凝膠。該公司由 Nathan J. Givoni 和 Simon H. Szewach 於 2018 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Aterian, Inc. is a technology enabled consumer products company. The company's brands include hOme, Vremi, Xtava and RIF6. Its product categories include home and kitchen appliances, kitchenware, environmental appliances, beauty related products and consumer electronics. The company was founded by Yaniv Sarig Zion in 2014 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Aterian, Inc. 是一家技術支援的消費品公司。該公司的品牌包括 hOme、Vremi、Xtava 和 RIF6。其產品類別包括家居及廚房電器、廚具、環保電器、美容相關產品及消費性電子產品。該公司由 Yaniv Sarig Zion 於 2014 年創立，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Draganfly, Inc. is a leader in cutting-edge drone solutions and software that are transforming industries and serving stakeholders globally. Its products include quad-copters, fixed wing aircrafts, ground based robots, hand held controllers, and software used for tracking, live streaming, and data collection. The firm also offers custom engineering, training, simulation consulting, as well as data and flight training services. The company was founded by Zenon Dragan and Christine Dragan in 1998 and is headquartered in Saskatoon, Canada.
info.description_zh: Draganfly, Inc. 是尖端無人機解決方案和軟體領域的領導者，致力於改變行業並為全球利益相關者提供服務。其產品包括四軸飛行器、固定翼飛機、地面機器人、手持控制器以及用於追蹤、直播和數據收集的軟體。該公司還提供客製化工程、培訓、模擬諮詢以及數據和飛行培訓服務。該公司由 Zenon Dragan 和 Christine Dragan 於 1998 年創立，總部位於加拿大薩斯卡通。

info.description: Conduent, Inc. delivers digital business solutions and services spanning the commercial, government and transportation spectrum creating valuable outcomes for clients and the millions of people who count on them. The cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, automation and advanced analytics deliver mission-critical solutions. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Industries, Government Services, and Transportation. The Commercial Industries segment offers business process services and customized solutions to clients in a variety of industries. The Government Services segment is involved in government-centric business process services and subject matter experts to U.S. federal, state, and local and foreign governments. The Transportation segment includes systems and support to transportation departments and agencies globally. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.

info.description: Heritage Global, Inc. engages in the provision of corporate and financial asset liquidation transactions, valuations, and advisory services. It operates through the following segments: Auction and Liquidation, Refurbishment and Resale, Brokerage, and Specialty Lending. The Auction and Liquidation segment focuses on operating a global full-service auction, appraisal, and asset advisory firm, including the acquisition of turnkey manufacturing facilities and used industrial machinery and equipment. The Refurbishment and Resale segment acquires, refurbishes, and supplies specialized laboratory equipment. The Brokerage segment manages charged-off receivables in the U.S. and Canada on behalf of financial institutions. The Specialty Lending segment provides specialty financing solutions to investors in charged-off and non-performing asset portfolios. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Heritage Global, Inc. 從事提供企業和金融資產清算交易、估值和諮詢服務。它透過以下部門運作：拍賣和清算、翻新和轉售、經紀和專業貸款。拍賣和清算部門​​專注於經營一家全球全方位服務拍賣、評估和資產諮詢公司，包括收購交鑰匙製造設施和二手工業機械和設備。翻新和轉售部門收購、翻新和供應專業實驗室設備。經紀部門代表金融機構管理美國和加拿大的應收帳款。專業貸款部門為沖銷和不良資產組合的投資者提供專業融資解決方案。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Akari Therapeutics Plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics to treat orphan autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded on October 7, 2004 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Akari Therapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它致力於治療孤兒自體免疫疾病和發炎性疾病的療法的開發和商業化。該公司成立於2004年10月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Cresud SA engages in the production of basic agricultural commodities. It operates through the Agricultural Business, and Urban Properties and Investment Business segments. The Agricultural Business segment engages in the operation of crop production, cattle feeding, raising, fattening and slaughtering, milk production, sugarcane production, brokerage activities, and sale of supplies. The Urban and Investment Business segment comprises of Operation Center in Argentina, which includes shopping malls, offices, sales and development, hotels, international operations, entertainment activities, and corporate activities, and Operation Center in Israel, which consists of real estate, supermarkets, telecommunications, insurance, other diverse business, and holding companies activities. The company was founded on December 31, 1936 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Cresud SA 從事基本農產品的生產。它透過農業業務、城市房地產和投資業務部門運作。農業業務部門從事農作物生產、牛隻飼養、飼養、育肥及屠宰、牛奶生產、甘蔗生產、經紀活動及物資銷售等業務。城市與投資業務部門包括阿根廷營運中心（包括購物中心、辦公大樓、銷售和開發、酒店、國際營運、娛樂活動和企業活動）和以色列營運中心（包括房地產、超市、電信、保險、其他多元化業務和控股公司活動）。該公司成立於1936年12月31日，總部位於阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯。

info.description: Linkhome Holdings, Inc. is an artificial intelligence-driven real estate technology company, which engages in the provision of mobile application for the buying and selling of properties. It also focuses on real estate solutions and services including real estate brokerage services, cash offer, property rental management, and home renovation. info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The investment strategy combines quantitative screening through a proprietary alpha model with fundamental research to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies across all market capitalizations positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該投資策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型進行定量篩選與基礎研究相結合，建立一個多元化的投資組合，針對所有市值的公司，這些公司定位於可持續盈利增長，並以有吸引力的估值進行積極的盈利修正。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. info.description: Air T, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of overnight air freight service to the express delivery industry, manufactures and sells aircraft deicers and other industrial equipment, and provides ground support equipment and facilities maintenance to airlines. info.description: PolyPid Ltd. operates as a phase 3 biopharma company. Its proprietary PLEX technology pairs with medications, enables precise delivery of drugs at effective release rates, over pre-determined durations ranging from several days to months. The firm's product candidates are designed to address unmet medical needs by delivering active pharmaceutical ingredients, or APIs, locally at predetermined release rates and durations over extended periods ranging from days to several months. The company was founded by Noam Emanuel on February 28, 2008 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.

info.description: Galaxy Digital, Inc. engages in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. It operates through the following segments: Digital Assets, Data Centers, and Treasury and Corporate. The digital assets segment offers institutional access to trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. The Data Centers segment competes with a range of infrastructure providers that are building or repurposing facilities to support the rapidly growing demand for AI and compute-intensive workloads. The Treasury and Corporate segment includes the company's proprietary trading and mining activities, as well as the company's principal investments and related gains and losses. The company was founded by Michael Novogratz in 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Digital, Inc. 從事數位資產和資料中心基礎設施業務，提供可加速金融和人工智慧進步的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：數位資產、資料中心、財務和企業部門。數位資產領域為機構提供交易、諮詢、資產管理、質押、自我託管和代幣化技術的存取權。資料中心部門與一系列基礎設施供應商競爭，這些供應商正在建造或重新利用設施，以支援對人工智慧和運算密集型工作負載快速成長的需求。財務和公司部門包括公司的自營交易和採礦活動，以及公司的主要投資和相關損益。該公司由 Michael Novogratz 於 2018 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OKTA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OKTA. The company was founded on January 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: MMTec, Inc. 持有 MM Future 的股權。它透過顧家、MM Future 和 HC Securities 以及 MM Global 部門進行運作。顧家、MM期貨和慧聰證券部門提供市場數據和諮詢服務。 MM Global部門引進經紀商，透過清算經紀交易商清算所有交易，並從客戶那裡賺取佣金收入、配售代理服務費和其他相關收入。該公司成立於2018年1月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: 20/20 Biolabs, Inc. engages in development and commercialization of proteomics product line. Its products include One Test, PAULA's Test and BioCheck Suspisious Powder Testing Kit. The company was founded by Jonathan Cohen in May 2000 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.description_zh: 20/20 Biolabs, Inc. 從事蛋白質體學產品線的開發和商業化。其產品包括One Test、PAULA's Test和BioCheck可疑粉末檢測試劑盒。該公司由 Jonathan Cohen 於 2000 年 5 月創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: Krystal Biotech, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company, which engages in discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of pharmaceutical products. It offers the product, VYJUVEK. The company was founded by Krish S. Krishnan and Suma M. Krishnan on April 15, 2016 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Krystal Biotech, Inc. 是一家生技公司，從事醫藥產品的發現、開發、製造和商業化。它提供產品 VYJUVEK。該公司由 Krish S. Krishnan 和 Suma M. Krishnan 於 2016 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Corvex, Inc. is an AI cloud computing company, which specializes in GPU-accelerated infrastructure for AI workloads. Its products include GPU Clusters, Confidential Computing, Inference as a Service and GPU Node. The firm offers solutions include AI model builders, enterprises, federal and sovereign solutions. The company was founded by Seth Mitchell Demsey, Jay Crystal on October 21, 2024 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: Corvex, Inc. 是一家人工智慧雲端運算公司，專門為人工智慧工作負載提供 GPU 加速基礎架構。其產品包括GPU叢集、機密運算、推理即服務和GPU節點。該公司提供的解決方案包括人工智慧模型建構器、企業、聯邦和主權解決方案。該公司由 Seth Mitchell Demsey、Jay Crystal 於 2024 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Bolt Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer. Its pipeline includes BDC-1001, a HER2-targeting Boltbody Immune-Stimulating Antibody Conjugate (ISAC), BDC-3042, a myeloid-modulating antibody, and multiple Boltbody ISAC collaboration programs. The company was founded by Edgar G. Engleman on January 22, 2015 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.

info.description_zh: Bolt Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，開發用於治療癌症的新型免疫療法。其管道包括BDC-1001（一種針對HER2的Boltbody免疫刺激抗體偶聯物（ISAC））、BDC-3042（一種骨髓調節抗體）和多個Boltbody ISAC合作計畫。該公司由 Edgar G. Engleman 於 2015 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: ImmunityBio, Inc. is a clinical stage immunotherapy company. It develops next generation therapies that drive immunogenic mechanisms for defeating cancers and infectious diseases. The company's immunotherapy platform activates both the innate and adaptive immune systems to create long term immunological memory. ImmunityBio was founded by Patrick Soon-Shiong in 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: ImmunityBio, Inc.是一家臨床階段免疫療法公司。它開發下一代療法，驅動免疫原性機制來戰勝癌症和傳染病。該公司的免疫治療平台可激活先天性和適應性免疫系統，以創建長期免疫記憶。 ImmunityBio 由 Patrick Soon-Shiong 於 2014 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Gulf Resources, Inc. is a holding company that engages in the manufacture of chemical products. It operates through the following segments: Bromine, Crude Salt, Chemical Products, and Natural Gas. It produces and trades bromine, crude salt and natural gas, and manufactures and sells chemical products used in oil and gas field exploration, oil and gas distribution, and oil field drilling. The firm also supplies papermaking chemical agents, inorganic chemicals, and manufactures materials for human and animal antibiotics. The company was founded by Ming Yang on February 28, 1989 and is headquartered in Shouguang, China.
info.description_zh: Gulf Resources, Inc.是一家從事化學產品製造的控股公司。該公司透過以下部門營運：溴部門、原鹽部門、化學產品部門和天然氣部門。它生產和貿易溴、原鹽和天然氣，並製造和銷售用於油氣田勘探、油氣分配和油田鑽井的化學產品。該公司還供應造紙化學製劑、無機化學品以及生產人類和動物抗生素材料。該公司由明陽於1989年2月28日創立，總部位於中國壽光。

info.description: Gamehaus Holdings, Inc. operates as a mobile game publishing company. It engages in partnering with small- and medium-sized game developers for game publishing solutions. The company was founded by Feng Xie on August 25, 2016 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Gamehaus Holdings, Inc. 是一家手機遊戲發行公司。它與中小型遊戲開發商合作提供遊戲發行解決方案。該公司由謝鋒於2016年8月25日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Empery Digital, Inc. engages in the design and development of electric outdoor power sports vehicles. It also offers electric two and four-wheel motorcycles and utility terrain vehicles. The company was founded by Christian Gerard Okonsky and Adrian James on February 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
